item.title: IHH Manages Insurance-Driven Delays As Patient Safety Events
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

item.title: Age Caps Are Blocking Experienced Doctors From Specialist Training — Medical Officer
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The public health system needs more specialists, yet rigid age limits block long-serving doctors from specialist training, even if self-funded. The policy risks wasting experienced talent and undermining efforts to expand the public sector specialist workforce. item.title: Coronary Stent Excluded From Civil Servants’ GL Coverage In Public Hospitals: UiTM
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
UiTM says coronary stents are not covered under civil servants’ guarantee letters (GL) for treatment in UiTM Hospital, in line with procedures in MOH hospitals. Stents are categorised as special devices, for which applicants can request financial aid. item.title: Pharmacist Contract Delays Trigger Talent Loss To Private Sector, Senator Warns
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Senator RA Lingeshwaran says delays in permanent appointments are pushing pharmacists out of MOH. Of 352 reserve candidates awaiting posts, 209 have left. He warned MOH cannot keep a “wait for vacancies” hiring model if it drives talent to the private sector. The post Pharmacist Contract Delays Trigger Talent Loss To Private Sector, Senator Warns appeared first on CodeBlue .
